scope: Read-only electrical/analog review of ADS1296_RevA4_TinySocket_CapFix; no PCB or schematic changes
conclusion: The main analog topology and pin connections are consistent with manufacturer guidance. This is still a bench prototype, not a physically validated electrode acquisition system. No confirmed reversed pin or incorrect nominal VCAP/reference value was found in this analog review. Ordering readiness remains conditional on exact parts, capacitor qualifications and the separate mechanical and power/data safety decisions.

connections_reviewed.ADS1296_TQFP64: All 64 names/pad numbers compared to TI PAG pin tables. Six channel pairs correct; unused IN7/IN8 and test/RLDIN pins tied to AVDD; RESV1 and DAISY_IN grounded; AVSS/DGND grounds, AVDD/AVDD1 and DVDD supplies consistent; RLDREF open only works with internal reference selection.

TPD4E001DBVR.6: negative clamp for inputs; unused for U9

connections_reviewed.ESD_package_caveat: TPD4E001RDBVR has a different VCC/GND pin arrangement and must not be substituted. DCK, DRL, DRS and DPK packages must not be substituted into the SOT-23-6 footprint without a new check.

ordering_gates.action: Keep ADS1296IPAG/IPAGR TQFP-64, LP5907MFX-3.3/NOPB SOT-23-5 and TPD4E001DBVR SOT-23-6. Keep the 24 electrode input resistors at 0.1% thin-film and the six 1.8nF capacitors at C0G 5%; generic precision substitutions need actual specifications.

Obtain part-specific DC-bias/ESR curves or confirmation for C2/C3 at their real rail voltages, and C14/C16/C18/C19/C20 at their node voltages. The nominal BOM does not prove effective capacitance. TI LP5907 requires actual input/output capacitance >=0.7uF after bias, tolerance and temperature, and output ESR in its specified range. Do not use an unsupported percentage loss estimate as evidence.

The current carrier and USB kit contain no galvanic isolation. Direct body electrodes plus externally powered/grounded USB is not a reviewed human-recording arrangement. Resolve this separately; the series resistors and ESD chips do not replace isolation.

firmware_and_bench_gates.finding: There is no passive input bias return and no input AC coupling. RLD powered down is appropriate for initial internal-short/test/dummy bring-up, but cannot be the final recording condition unless an alternate bias is provided.
firmware_and_bench_gates.current_hardware_option: After dummy-load validation, enable the internal RLD midpoint and RLD buffer, connect J8 pin1 to a bias electrode, and initially leave RLD_SENSP/RLD_SENSN zero for buffered midpoint bias. Add CH1-only common-mode feedback only after a real-load stability check.

firmware_and_bench_gates.finding: The 1Mohm parallel 1.5nF feedback is a TI example, not a phase-margin guarantee. The 220kohm output resistance and actual cable/electrode capacitances change the loop. No real-load stability measurement or verified full RLD loop model exists for this exact board.
firmware_and_bench_gates.validation: Check RLDOUT for settling, oscillation, rail saturation and recovery on dummy electrode/cable loads. Start with fixed midpoint bias; if using active feedback, test selected sensing pairs and disconnections.

firmware_and_bench_gates.finding: DC electrode offset and common-mode interference reach the PGA. Gain6 is a starting point, not a universal optimum; reduce gain if raw samples approach clipping. A later software HPF cannot recover clipped readings.

The board has a first-order differential low-pass plus ADC digital decimation. There is no analog high-pass or mains notch. PC-side 20-450Hz filtering/notch is a project choice that needs whole-cascade validation; save raw readings too.

Internal reference buffer is disabled after reset. Firmware must select internal2.4V reference, HR4kSPS, desired gains and internal RLD midpoint as appropriate; wait for supplies/VCAP1 and perform reset/configuration/readback. Do not assume default registers implement the target configuration.

No measured board noise, electrode/cable noise, motion artifact, RF immunity or RLD rejection result exists. Compare internal-short noise with externally shorted/bias-held input noise, then controlled waveform and electrode recordings.

input_filter_calculations.assumptions: Ideal negligible-impedance electrode sources; no cable/electrode parasitics; six equal input networks
input_filter_calculations.caveat: Actual electrode resistance increases filter attenuation, and parasitic imbalance can convert common-mode to differential noise. The pole is not a statement of effective system bandwidth or complete immunity.

noise_calculations.formula: sqrt(4*k*T*R*noise_bandwidth), with RC weighting for the exact band integral
noise_calculations.excluded: Electrode and cable noise, input/clamp leakage fluctuations, ADC noise, power switching, RLD noise, aliases and environmental interference
noise_calculations.cross_check: Agrees with older executed A1 ideal input-network ngspice result; this is not a physical test of CapFix
noise_calculations.ADC_typical_conditions: HR4kSPS/gain6/3V analog/internal2.4V reference/shorted inputs; full device-filter bandwidth
noise_calculations.do_not_claim: Do not call the ADC table value measured board performance or directly add values with different bandwidths. 24-bit codes are not24 noise-free bits.

range_calculations.current_caveat: These voltage ranges assume valid supply/reference and common-mode. They are not a finger EMG amplitude guarantee.

capacitors.VCAP1: C16=22uF16V X5R1210 plus C17=100nF16V X7R0805; nominal values match TI
capacitors.VCAP2_3_4: C18/C19/C20=1uF16V X7R0805 each; nominal values match TI. VCAP3 nominally AVDD+1.9V, approximately5.2V here, so its voltage rating must exceed the internal elevated voltage
capacitors.reference: C14=10uF16V X5R1206 plus C15=100nF16V X7R0805 between VREFP and GND; VREFN grounded
capacitors.ferroelectric_caveat: C14/C16 and supply X5R/X7R parts have DC-bias, aging and piezoelectric effects. TI specifically warns VCAP1 vibration/microphonics can degrade reference performance. This is a motion-sensing wearable; mechanical isolation and an actual tap/movement test matter.
capacitors.exact_DC_bias_status: The manufacturer exact-part nominal ratings were verified, but numerical guaranteed effective capacitance at operating voltage/temperature/age was not obtained. Accessible manufacturer reports describe their curves as typical simulations, not guaranteed limits. No percentage derating is asserted here.
capacitors.LP5907_screen_assumption: 5.5uF*1.10*1.15; ignores voltage/age effects and is not a full effective-capacitance qualification
capacitors.LP5907_current_range: Output capacitor specified1-10uF nominal application range, actual minimum0.7uF after tolerance/bias/temperature, ESR5-500milliohm. Local C2/C3=2.2uF16V X7R. Input>=1uF nominal and actual>=0.7uF; input within1cm, more input bulk if long inductive supply leads.
capacitors.not_direct_AVDD_loading: C14/C15 reference and C16-C20 internal nodes must not be blindly added to LP5907's direct output capacitance. Current direct rail does not contain15uF.

RLD_calculations.safety_caveat: Only low-voltage resistor arithmetic. This is not isolation, aggregate patient leakage, fault analysis or safety certification; other electrode paths and externally grounded equipment remain relevant.
RLD_calculations.published_comparison: TI SBAA188 tests1M||1.5nF using1 sensed channel and output protection50/75/100k; this does not verify our220k/cable/electrode combination.

TPD4E001_limits.stated_electrical_table_conditions: VCC5V +/-10%; manufacturer operation range includes3.3V but do not claim a measured3.3V leakage result
TPD4E001_limits.caveat: These are illustrative DC voltage drops, not an RMS noise specification or actual channel offset; source impedance and bias matter. Chip IEC ESD ratings do not prove assembled PCB protection.

proposed_TPD4E1U06DBVR_substitution.status: Pin-compatible candidate, not approved as an electrically equivalent or fully qualified AFE substitute; native schematic and BOM remain unchanged
proposed_TPD4E1U06DBVR_substitution.pin_compatibility: DBV SOT-23-6: IO1/3/4/6, GND2, NC5. TI permits NC5 floating, grounded or connected to VCC, so existing AVDD3.3V at pin5 is allowed.
proposed_TPD4E1U06DBVR_substitution.normal_input_range: 0-5.5V recommended IO range; correctly biased EMG around1.65V is inside it. This device needs no supply.
proposed_TPD4E1U06DBVR_substitution.protection_difference: Ground-referenced TVS, not a3.3V rail clamp. Minimum breakdown6.5V; typical clamp11V at1A or15V at3A,8/20us. ADS input protection and rail injection must be assessed as a cascade; ESD system protection is not proven.
proposed_TPD4E1U06DBVR_substitution.leakage_spec: 1nA typical,10nA maximum at IO2.5V. No exact maximum at the proposed1.65V operating point is specified. The original part's1nA maximum uses different conditions, so do not assert noise equivalence.
proposed_TPD4E1U06DBVR_substitution.capacitance_spec: 0.8pF typical/1pF maximum at1MHz,2.5V,25C; mismatch0.07pF maximum at2.5V. No assembled-channel CMRR claim follows.
proposed_TPD4E1U06DBVR_substitution.own_illustrative_offset_calculation: 10nA*22kohm=220uV per input leg, or440uV with opposite leg leakage; electrode source impedance adds further drop. This is DC arithmetic, not RMS noise or a measured offset.
proposed_TPD4E1U06DBVR_substitution.required_decision: Explicitly approve and update the exact BOM/symbol identity before purchasing as a substitute. Keep pins5/2 as verified. Compare input DC offsets, rail behavior, shorted-input noise and transient recovery on dummy loads before electrodes; do not claim the alternate device certifies human safety.
